entryBuild.name: The Website
entryBuild.text: The entry build: a fast one-page site with your real services, one price list, your booking link one tap away, and your real reviews on the surface. Quoted fixed before work starts.

headline: Your website, booking and reviews — run like a front office, not a side project.

howItWorks.text: We audit your current site — booking path, prices, reviews, mobile speed — and show you the findings in plain English.
You get a labelled preview of your redesigned page before you pay for anything. Previews are marked as concepts until they are your live site.
A person approves everything that leaves the office. Nothing is sent, posted or published without a human yes.
The roles below do the recurring work every week, and you get one report on what each one actually produced.

intakeNote: FOUNDER: replace FOUNDER-FORM-ID with the real form endpoint before deploy (see monday-launch-plan-2026-11-01.md §1). Until then this form does not deliver anywhere.
pilotNote: SiteBefore is built in Toronto and is currently in pilot: a Niagara Falls salon redesign built around a shorter path to a booked chair, one price list, and real reviews on the surface. No results are claimed for the pilot — it is in progress.
pricingPlaceholder: Pricing is set on a short call, and your quote is fixed before any work starts — the quote is the price, and changes are quoted before they are done, never after.

roles.name: The Front Desk
workflows: Answers the site chat and missed calls by text — and says it is automated when a customer interacts with it
Books into the booking flow you already use (e.g. LimeOrder)

roles.name: The Reputation Manager
roles.outcome: Every job you finish starts ranking for the next one.
workflows: Asks every finished client for a review at the moment of completion — the same ask for everyone, never gated
Publishes service × neighbourhood pages from real completed work
Keeps your listings (hours, phone) consistent everywhere

roles.name: The Marketer
roles.outcome: You see what each campaign actually produced.
workflows: Runs the offers and ads you approve — nothing runs unapproved
Reports what each campaign produced, in numbers

roles.name: The Office Manager (whole office)
roles.outcome: One office, one report, one point of contact.
workflows: All of the above, run as one office
The roles cover for each other
One monthly report instead of three

subhead: SiteBefore builds appointment businesses a website that books, then runs the weekly work behind it: enquiries answered, reviews collected, pages published. You approve everything before it goes out.

trust.text: The site, the domain, the content, the reviews — registered to your business, exportable any time.
The quote is the price; changes are quoted before they are done, never after.
Any automated receptionist or chat identifies itself as automated when a customer interacts with it.

trust.line: Your client data stays in your systems.
trust.text: We work inside the tools you already use; we do not pool or resell customer data.
Every mockup we show is marked as a concept until it is your live site.

trust.line: A person approves everything that leaves the office.
trust.text: Outreach and changes are drafted by the system and approved by a human before they send.
